reconciliation: Initial P3 diagnostic matched using ceil top-quartile and experiment-equal means; P4 main aggregates experiments within date, then dates equally
eligibility: At least 4 finite PCE labels in each (date,expID); same labeled evaluation patches for every method; no value-based removal

naive_rules.direction: descending positive for all 12 fixed rules; end_start_delta=late25% trimmed mean minus early25% trimmed mean; ND is a sensor control, not asserted PL

naive_selection.inner_folds: Sorted outer training dates in consecutive pairs, remaining dates are inner train; rule has no fitting, evaluate each on inner validation dates only
naive_selection.tie_break: top25 gain descending, then rule ID ascending

missing_P3_holdout_F2_ridge: Use P2 frozen F2_ridge historical predictions as a documented reference: same 14 training dates, 12 features and alpha=1; no new regressor training

pairwise_ranker.features: 12 P3 relative features: four channels mean,last,relative-index slope
pairwise_ranker.relative_definition: (x-experiment optical median)/max(1.4826*experiment optical MAD, training-only floor)
pairwise_ranker.floor: max(1e-12,0.01*median(abs(training-date optical feature))) using all optical patches in training dates
pairwise_ranker.group_context: all available optical patches of each current experiment; no PCE or label availability read
pairwise_ranker.standard_scaler: fit on all optical patches from training dates only, before pair differences
pairwise_ranker.pairs: all unordered within-training-experiment pairs with abs(PCE_i-PCE_j)>=0.5; add both signed orientations; deterministic sorted sample IDs; no sampling
pairwise_ranker.pair_weights: each contributing date has equal total weight, within date each contributing experiment equal, within experiment pairs equal; normalize weights to mean 1
pairwise_ranker.hyperparameter_selection: none; one fixed C and feature family
pairwise_ranker.prediction: standardized relative feature dot fitted coefficient, no PCE calibration or clipping

metrics.spearman: average ranks, undefined for constant prediction/target; never replace with zero
metrics.top_ties: descending score then ascending unique sample_id; true top ties same stable rule; boundary tie counts reported
metrics.gain: true PCE mean among predicted top ceil(n*0.25) minus all eligible labeled patch PCE mean in that experiment
metrics.aggregate: experiment equally within date, then date equally

random.theory: rho expected 0 when defined, top25 overlap k/n, PCE gain 0, pair concordance 0.5; constant targets retain undefined rho
random.simulation: independent uniform permutations per experiment, stable SHA256-derived RNG seed; align replicate index only for date/macro summaries

paired_comparisons: All learned/frozen P3 models vs NAIVE_INNER_SELECTED; dates are bootstrap unit, 10000 replicates, descriptive intervals only
sensitivity: floor vs ceil initial reconciliation; concordance for abs(PCE difference)>=1 vs all non-tied pairs; all low-PCE patches retained; fixed-score ties explicitly audited
